lead: `nvs-host`'s clock-reading watchdog tests fail under `nv verify`'s side-by-side test run and pass alone, so the gate goes red on a crate your slice never touched.
body: `a_capped_request_publishes_a_baseline_and_an_uncapped_one_publishes_nothing` and `a_run_that_is_no_core_is_sampled_and_reported_never` measure process CPU time every other test binary competes for, and `the_watchdog_reports_a_wedged_worker_without_a_heartbeat` allows a heartbeat a 250 ms wall-clock margin the same load eats, so which of the three fails varies per run. Read the failing name before looking for your own change in it; a rerun only moves it, and it stops the gate before the `.nvst` trees and clippy have run at all.
